scope: Directional page-turn presentation, focus ownership, cancellation, external geometry/restoration, preference regression, and signed local update.

presentation.measurement: Monotonic elapsed time from select() to completed presentation with confirmed native keyboard focus, including outgoing native snapshot preparation, focus handoff, page-turn animation when enabled, and diagnostic polling. Successful switches only; no fixed latency pass/fail budget.

Monotonic elapsed time from select() to completed presentation with confirmed system-wide AX keyboard focus, including bounded outgoing snapshot preparation, focus handoff, page-turn animation when enabled, diagnostic polling, and AX readback. Successful switches only; no fixed cross-application latency pass/fail budget.
